name: Example: investigate only when errors were found
description: Every 30 minutes counts splunkd errors by component. An If… node checks $count_errors.resultCount$ > 0: only then does the investigate step list the latest errors of the busiest component; otherwise it is skipped and the run still succeeds.

steps.name: Count errors by component
steps.spl:
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd log_level=ERROR
| stats count BY component
| sort - count

steps.name: Investigate the busiest component
steps.spl:
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd log_level=ERROR component=$count_errors.first.component$
| head 50
| table _time host component _raw
